description:
ICF’s Digital Modernization Division is a rapidly growing, entrepreneurial, technology department, seeking an ITSM Process Implementer experienced in ServiceNow ITSM Implementations to support the current needs of our federal customers.
 
 Our Digital Modernization Division is an information technology and management consulting department that offers integrated, strategic solutions to its public and private-sector clients. ICF has the expertise, agility, and commitment to design, build, and operate high-performance IT engines to support all aspects of our client’s business.
 
 ICF’s IT Modernization division is a rapidly growing, entrepreneurial, technology-driven department, seeking an ITSM Process Implementer with a technical consultant background to coordinate a team of subject matter experts in developing and implementing best-practice service management designs and architectures of technical ITSM and functional ITIL solutions for a variety of Federal clients, including the National Institutes of Health (NIH).
 
 Job Location: Remote (USA). Local candidates may be expected to work at the client site in Rockville, MD 1-2 days per week. Travel for a conference or to another ICF location for collaboration may be required once a year.
 
 This position requires that the job be performed in the United States. If you accept this position, you should note that ICF does monitor employee work locations and blocks access from foreign locations/foreign IP addresses and also prohibits personal VPN connections.
 
 Responsibilities include: 
 Define, prioritize, and communicate the vision and roadmap for CMDB products and services, in alignment with the client's goals and needs.
 Collaborate with ITSM process owners, managers, and stakeholders to elicit, analyze, and validate requirements for ITSM products and services, using agile methodologies and tools.
 Design, configure, and implement the ServiceNow ITSM platform to meet client requirements, focusing on ITIL best practices in collaboration with professional development teams
 ServiceNow Platform Expertise : Deep knowledge of the ServiceNow platform, including ITSM, workflows, and administration. Experience with ITSM implementation on ServiceNow Platform
 Discovery & Service Mapping - Implement Discovery for all classes and deploy Service Mapping for all CMDB classes populated through Discovery and then connect the AWS environment to the CMDB - install Discovery and Service Mapping for those CIs
 Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify challenges and propose solutions.
 Data Governance & Quality Assurance : Assess subscription unit usage and forecast future needs. Establish data certification/attestation process for CMDB stakeholders without native ServiceNow access
 Mature the current attestation pilot.
 Migrate CMDB data from CSDM 3 to CSDM 5, in collaboration with the ServiceNow Platform and Development teams.
 Maintain CMDB accuracy and reliability through: Automated scripts (duplicate removal, data refresh).
 Intelligent Reconciliation Engine (IRE) policies.
 Misclassification cleanup.
 
 Develop and implement CMDB data audits and validation methodologies.
 Track and manage Service Accounts and Privileged Accounts.
 Finalize Certificate Management capabilities in the CMDB.
 
 Integrations Integrate the CMDB with Hardware and Software Asset Management modules.
 Connect the ServiceNow Configuration Management module with Flexera Data Platform to capture software usage, end-of-life details, and other key insights.
 
 Documentation & Reporting Create Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for completed work.
 Develop dashboards and reports to support monitoring, auditing, and decision-making.
 
 Maturity & Continuous Improvement Advance and mature the CMDB workspace.
 Transition the NCI CMDB project from the walk stage to the fly stage.
 Perform other duties as assigned.
 
 
 Technical Skills: 
 Proficiency in JavaScript, REST/SOAP APIs, HTML, CSS, and web services
 Strong understanding of IT Service Management processes and ITIL frameworks.
 
  Required Qualifications: 
 Bachelor’s degree
 ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) required
 6+ years of overall ServiceNow experience, to include implementing Discovery, Service Mapping, Integrations and CSDM Migration on the ServiceNow Platform
 US Citizen or Green Card Holder due to federal contract requirements.
 MUST RESIDE IN THE United States (U.S.) and the work MUST BE PERFORMED in the United States (U.S.), as this work is for a federal contract and laws do apply.
 
 Preferred: 
 ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) - ITSM
